jobs.title: ECM Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a compassionate and organized **ECM Care Coordinator** to support individuals enrolled in Enhanced Care Management (ECM). This role coordinates care, conducts member outreach and follow\-up, schedules services, maintains accurate documentation, and connects members with healthcare and community resources. The ideal candidate is dependable, detail\-oriented, and committed to helping individuals overcome barriers to care.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day **Enhanced Care Management (ECM)** services and support member engagement throughout the care management process.
* Conduct member outreach, enrollment support, follow\-ups, and ongoing communication to promote participation in ECM services.
* Schedule and coordinate appointments, referrals, follow\-up services, and care\-related activities.
* Assist members with navigating medical, behavioral health, social service, and community\-based resources.
* Coordinate with healthcare providers, care teams, community organizations, and other service partners to support continuity of care.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of member outreach, referrals, care coordination activities, services, and follow\-up efforts.
* Track member eligibility, enrollment, authorizations, referrals, and service activity to ensure appropriate and timely follow\-up.
* Support ECM claims, encounters, billing documentation, and required reporting, including identifying and resolving missing or incomplete information.
* Maintain accurate member information within electronic health records, care management platforms, health plan portals, and internal tracking systems.
* Assist with obtaining required records, documentation, and information from members, providers, and partner organizations.
* Connect members with resources addressing social needs, including housing, food, transportation, benefits, behavioral health, and other supportive services.
* Follow established ECM program requirements, documentation standards, workflows, and organizational procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality of member information and comply with HIPAA and applicable privacy requirements.
* Participate in case coordination, team meetings, audits, quality improvement activities, and other ECM operational activities as needed.
* Provide scheduling and administrative support related to ECM operations and perform other duties related to the position..

**Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Professional and courteous phone etiquette
* Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, spreadsheets, and data tracking
* Comfortable with data entry, reporting, and maintaining organized electronic records
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and general computer applications
* Ability to learn and navigate electronic health records (EHR), healthcare portals, and care management systems
* Member outreach, engagement, and follow\-up
* Appointment scheduling and referral coordination
* Accurate and timely documentation and recordkeeping
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Ability to manage multiple members, tasks, priorities, and deadlines
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Problem\-solving skills and ability to follow established procedures
* Ability to communicate professionally with members, healthcare providers, health plans, and community partners
* Understanding of HIPAA, confidentiality, and handling sensitive information
* Dependable, professional, and able to work independently and as part of a team
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred

Pay: $25\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Social Work Case Manager
jobs.description:
Home \& Health Care Management is the oldest home health care agency in Northern California. Our agency specializes in delivering comprehensive in\-home care and case management for older adults, children, and those living with disabilities across many counties. We use a matrix of Medi\-Cal, Medicare and targeted health programs to find solutions that work for our clients.

 **Overview of the Role**



We want to hire bachelor’s prepared Social Workers (or another related field such as Gerontology) who will work with a Care Management Team (CMT) consisting of Master’s or Bachelor’s prepared Social Worker and Registered Nurse team to provide comprehensive case management services to target population.

 **Who You Are:**



You are a Master's or Bachelor’s Prepared Social Worker (BSW) passionate about making a difference in the lives of individuals.



You are detail oriented, computer literate, and want to work as part of a management team supervising the care of clients who are receiving home and community\-based services.



You are good at problem solving, knowledgeable about community resources, and enjoy helping clients solve social determinants of health care problems.



You want a workplace that values the significant differences Social Workers can make to the health and welfare of clients.



You like working 8am\-5pm on weekdays with no weekend work.

 **Responsibilities:**


* Assists the team with finding community resources (i.e., housing; medical equipment and supplies; primary care physician and specialists; essential items like food, clothing, and household goods; medical transportation; and caregivers, etc.) needed to meet the participant’s needs.
* Engages in advocacy efforts to ensure participants receive timely medical services to remain safe in the community
* Responds timely to questions and enquiries from CMT, participants, and other entities for smooth patient care coordination
* Provides education to participants so they can better understand the benefits of services and community supports.
* Assists participants with applications (i.e., Medi\-Cal; IHSS; Calfresh; and Regional Center, etc.). Explains eligibility requirements, coordinates transportation for participants and other basic needs of support
* Document all consumer interaction and maintain timely reporting and documentation requirements
* Observes participants behavior; reports significant changes to supervisor or team; documents appropriately
* Daily case conference with CMT about shared participants
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

  


**Essential Requirements:**


* Master's degree or Bachelor’s degree in Social Work or another related field
* Skilled in operating a personal computer utilizing a variety of standard software
* Valid California Driver’s License and eligible to be insured under our liability policy with a clean DMV report
* Your own vehicle and proof of current auto insurance
* CPR certificate required within 30 days of hire

  


**Preferred Skills, Knowledge and Certifications**


* Knowledge of basic problems and needs of people diagnosed with a physical disability or emotional disturbance
* Knowledge of community and supportive services
* Skilled in assessing and prioritizing multiple tasks, projects, and demands
* Skilled in working within deadlines to complete projects and assignments
* Skilled in establishing and maintaining effective working relations with co\-workers and other community providers
* Experience with electronic medical records

  


**Location and Service Region:**



This is not a remote role, and you are required to work from our Sacramento office.



You will need your own car and be able to travel to client’s homes in Sacramento County and the greater surrounding area. Work is performed in a community and office environment.



PPE is provided to all employees.



Transporting clients with personal vehicle is prohibited

  


**Schedule**:

  

Full time, 40 hours per week, from Monday through Friday from 8am to 5pm with an hour for lunch. No weekend work.

  

Currently 20% of the time is related to direct home visits, 80% of the time is telehealth video visits and or calls and documentation in the office.

  


**Physical Requirements:**



Job offer is conditional upon successfully passing a medical exam that tests amongst other things the ability to move, visual acuity, and hearing acuity. Physical requirement for this role specifically includes


* Sits, stands, bends, lifts, walks, and moves intermittently during working hours
* Able to lift to 35 pounds without assistance
* Able to drive intermittently

  


**Compensation:**



Pay range is $26\.00 \- $33\.00 / hour. Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience.

  

We value our employees and are proud to offer competitive compensation and benefits package, which may include:


* Medical, Dental \& Vision Insurance
* Company\-Paid Life Insurance
* Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* FSA (Medical and Dependent Care)
* Aflac
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Leave \& Holidays)
* Monthly phone Stipend
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Mileage Reimbursement (For Eligible Positions)
* Company Vehicles Available (For Eligible Positions)

  


**Apply**

  

If you have an interest in joining our amazing team, we would like to hear from you!

  



Click here to apply online.

  



You can also download the application packet located at www.homeandhealthcaremgmt.com and fax completed applications to 530\-487\-8585 or mail to us at 1398 Ridgewood Dr., Chico, CA 95973, Attention: HR Department.

jobs.description:
**IHP Housing Navigator – TAY Program**

**Organization:** Ella’s Foundation  
**Location:** Normandie Site, Los Angeles, California  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Schedule:** Monday – Friday; 8am\-4:30pm  
**Compensation:** $26\.00\-$28\.00 per hour

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized individual to serve as an IHP Housing Navigator for Ella’s Foundation’s Transitional Age Youth (TAY) population. The Housing Navigator will assist young adults experiencing homelessness—including individuals with mental health needs and other barriers—with transitioning from interim housing to safe, stable, permanent housing.

**About Ella’s Foundation**

Ella’s Foundation provides trauma\-informed, person\-centered services to Transitional Age Youth (TAY), ages 18–25, experiencing homelessness, mental health challenges, substance\-use concerns, and other barriers to stable housing.

We are seeking a compassionate, resourceful, and highly organized Housing Navigator to support participants in our Department of Mental Health Interim Housing Program (DMH IHP). This position helps participants move from interim housing into safe, stable, and permanent housing.

**Essential Responsibilities**

* Complete housing assessments and develop individualized housing stability plans.
* Help participants identify housing goals, barriers, preferences, and appropriate housing options.
* Locate available units and maintain current knowledge of affordable, supportive, and permanent housing resources.
* Build professional relationships with landlords, property managers, housing authorities, and community partners.
* Assist participants with housing applications, eligibility documents, identification, Social Security cards, income verification, disability documentation, and other required records.
* Support participants with housing interviews, unit viewings, lease reviews, and reasonable\-accommodation requests.
* Advocate for participants while promoting independence, informed decision\-making, and housing retention.
* Coordinate security deposits, move\-in assistance, household goods, transportation, and other housing\-related resources.
* Accompany participants to housing appointments, property management offices, and unit viewings as needed.
* Collaborate with DMH treatment teams, case managers, clinicians, program leadership, and community providers.
* Maintain timely, accurate, and confidential case notes, housing records, progress updates, and required program documentation.
* Enter and update information in HMIS and other required systems, when applicable.
* Participate in case conferences, multidisciplinary meetings, staff meetings, and required training.
* Apply Housing First, harm\-reduction, trauma\-informed care, and culturally responsive practices.
* Respond professionally to crises and immediately report safety concerns, critical incidents, or suspected abuse as required.
* Follow Ella’s Foundation policies, DMH standards, confidentiality requirements, and professional boundaries.

**Core Responsibilities**

**· Client Engagement:** Build positive rapport and trusting professional relationships with clients. Maintain consistent, respectful, and professional engagement with clients as part of the position’s daily responsibilities. Use trauma\-informed, culturally responsive, and client\-centered practices to encourage participation, address housing barriers, and support clients in meeting their individualized housing goals.

**Reporting and Supervision**

· **Supervision:** The IHP Housing Navigator will report directly to the Operations Coordinator, who will serve as the employee’s immediate supervisor. The Housing Navigator must maintain regular communication with the Operations Coordinator regarding client progress, housing barriers, documentation, program needs, and assigned responsibilities.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, human services, sociology, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
* At least one to two years of experience in housing navigation, homeless services, case management, behavioral health, or social services preferred.
* Experience working with TAY, people experiencing homelessness, or individuals with behavioral\-health needs strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of Housing First, harm reduction, trauma\-informed care, crisis intervention, and local housing resources.
* Strong communication, advocacy, organization, documentation, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a multidisciplinary team.
* Ability to manage multiple participant needs, deadlines, applications, and follow\-up requirements.
* Proficiency with email, Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, databases, and electronic documentation systems.
* Valid California driver’s license, reliable transportation, and current automobile insurance.
* Ability to travel throughout Los Angeles County for appointments and housing\-related activities.
* Ability to successfully complete all required pre\-employment screenings.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within a Los Angeles County DMH\-funded program.
* Familiarity with HMIS, Coordinated Entry System resources, housing authorities, voucher programs, and supportive\-housing referrals.
* Existing relationships with landlords, property managers, or community housing providers.
* Training in de\-escalation, crisis intervention, motivational interviewing, or trauma\-informed care.

**What We Value**

The successful candidate will be compassionate, dependable, resourceful, and persistent. They will recognize each participant’s strengths, maintain professional boundaries, protect confidentiality, and remain committed to helping young adults overcome barriers to permanent housing.
